= Tenant

Wraps another cache to namespace keys by the tenant ID associated with the incoming request. This is useful for a multi-tenant deployment where a custom provider varies its output per tenant (e.g. different imagery or authorization per organization) and a shared cache would otherwise leak one tenant's tiles to another.

The tenant ID is populated by xref:configuration/authentication/index.adoc[authentication]. A request with no tenant ID falls back to the same cache key it would use without this wrapper, so single-tenant deployments are unaffected.

Name should be "tenant"

Configuration options:

[cols="1,3,1,1,1"]
|===
| Parameter | Description | Type | Required | Default

| cache
| The wrapped Cache configuration
| Cache
| Yes
| None
|===

Example:

[,yaml]
----
cache:
  name: tenant
  cache:
    name: disk
    path: "./disk_tile_cache"
----
